analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($2,745.69) vs SMA5 ($2,615.82)/SMA20 ($2,507.86)/SMA50 ($2,290.69): confirmed above short/mid-term trends.
· High position relative to SMA100 ($2,035.7)/SMA200 ($2,079.5): maintaining long-term trend strength.
· 52-week position (38.1%) + current price level significantly above historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (51.8 → 71.0): confirmed entry into overbought territory, strengthening upward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-25.5829 → 10.6390): continued improvement, signaling bullish expansion.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near upper band $2,681.49): approaching upper band, 13.85% band width indicating expanding volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($2,720.44): above current price, confirmed strong support.
· Swing resistance ($2,765.55): potential for further upside upon breakout.
· 5-day high ($2,764.66) > 0.995 * 20-day high ($2,764.66), 5-day low ($2,412.19) > 1.005 * 20-day low ($2,356.19): confirmed Higher Low pattern.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.74x): increased confidence in upward movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (uptrend): enter on breakout above 2765.55, stop loss on break below 2645.71.
